parts.role: MCU: FOC control, 2x ADC, TIM1 BKIN comparators, HRTIM-class G4 family, pin/package-compatible alternate

3-phase 6-PWM gate driver. Verified: LCSC/datasheet feature line lists 'Built-in bootstrap diode' for the D suffix only; the N suffix (alternate, no integrated bootstrap diode, needs external boot diode per phase) omits it. D suffix confirmed correct per blocks.md 'integrated bootstrap diodes' decision.

60V power-stage FET, x6 per board (3 legs, HS+LS) plus x1 as the RP FET (Q101) = 7 per board. Datasheet-verified: Rds(on) 2.4 mOhm @ Vgs=10V (blocks.md claimed ~2 mOhm, confirmed), 60V, package SO-8FL confirmed. Qg not independently re-verified from the datasheet text extraction (illegible in fetch) but LCSC attribute states 52 nC@10V matching blocks.md; treat Qg as LCSC-sourced, not datasheet-page-confirmed. Alternate BSC028N06NS (blocks.md rejected-list alt) not found in parts_search live catalog under that exact string - flagged as unverified alternate, no LCSC id.

Current-sense amp, gain 20V/V, x3 per board. Re-searched per task: LCSC/stock reconfirmed live (27297 in stock, well over 5x*3legs*5boards=75). Package SOIC-8 pin-compatible alternate same family, different tube/reel code, lower stock (2049) but still >5x.

Reverse-polarity N-FET gate controller, non-blocking (regen-current-capable) per blocks.md decision #1/#6 (reverse-polarity-fet-no-blocking-for-regen-load knowledge record) - an ideal-diode/blocking part (LM5050/LM74700/LTC4357/LT4320 families, all searched) is functionally wrong here because it would block regen current and pump VBUS. LM74500-Q1 is TI's only non-blocking bidirectional-conduction RP controller on LCSC (single SKU, single source). RISK: stock is only 23 units against qty 5 boards x 1/board = 5 needed, but the skill's 5x rule (25) is not met - 23 < 25. No alternate exists that preserves the non-blocking function, so alternates is empty per rule 4. Re-verify stock close to order time; consider a small buffer buy now if stock drops further.
TVS clamp, 28V standoff / 45.4V clamp per blocks.md. Cheapest in-stock SMCJ28A SKU; alternate is a different brand/tube of the identical part number.
100V sync buck, VM -> +5V, 1A. Alternate is same part, tape-and-reel/tube variant, lower stock but still well over 5x.
+5V -> +12V boost for DRV8300 GVDD. Alternate same family, cheaper, also high stock.
+5V -> +3V3 LDO, 1A. Alternate same family, WSON package (footprint change, kept as a pin-count-compatible logical alternate only).

Low-side Kelvin current-sense shunt, x3 per board. 2512, 3W, 3 mOhm 1% matches architecture spec exactly (10A RMS/20A pk class per current-sense-shunt-selection-ladder record: 0.3W cont, 60mV peak at 20V/V gain).
Bulk electrolytic at VM entry, THT, >=470uF/>=35V per architecture (63V margin over the 45V clamp).
Per-leg HF ceramic bank, 3x per leg x3 legs = 9/board, per blocks.md '3x 10uF/50V X7R 1210 + 100nF directly across that leg'.
Per-leg 100nF companion cap in the 1210 bank, x3/board (one per leg).

1uF/50V X7R 0805, used in two roles: (a) bootstrap cap per phase, x3/board - per gate-driver-bootstrap-cboot-sizing record, DRV8300 p19 worked example gives Cmin ~59nF at this board's operating point, and 1uF matches blocks.md and the refdesign-power-stage record; (b) GVDD close-in HF ceramic, x1/board, the smaller of the two GVDD caps per DRV8300 p21 'two caps' guidance. 50V rating clears the >=2xVDD(12V)=24V derating rule. One distinct LCSC part, 4 placements/board. Basic part, no alternate needed.
GVDD bulk bypass, x1/board. Per gate-driver-bootstrap-gvdd-bypass-ratio record, GVDD cap must be >=10x Cboot (1uF) = 10uF minimum; 25V rating is the DS-recommended >=2xVDD(12V) floor. Basic part.
Series gate resistor, x6/board (one per FET), per refdesign-power-stage record and blocks.md '10 ohm series gate resistor'. Basic part.
Gate-source pull-down, x6/board (one per FET), per blocks.md and the refdesign-power-stage safety-default record. Also reused for the +3V3 pull-up ladder resistors where 10k is specified. Basic part.
Bus/phase divider top resistor (1:16 with the 10k bottom leg), x4/board (VBUS_SENSE + 3x VSENSE). Basic part.
Hall open-drain pull-ups to +3V3, x3/board (HA/HB/HC), per blocks.md io section. Basic part.
Series filter/ESD resistor on UART TX/RX and sensor connector lines per blocks.md io section. Basic part.
General 100nF bypass/filter: CSA supply bypass (current-sense-shunt-csa-bypass record, x3/board), divider filter caps (x4/board), MCU/CSA decoupling. Basic part, deep stock.
VDDA ferrite filter per blocks.md 'VDDA through a ferrite', x1/board. Basic part.
Power LED (+3V3 present), x1/board per blocks.md mcu section.
Status LED, x1/board.
Fault LED, x1/board.
SW1 reset + SW2 user, x2/board. Same part used for both switches.
Control connector: JST-GH 4-pin, GND/5V/TX/RX per blocks.md io section, x1/board.

Sensor connector: JST-GH 8-pin, 5V/GND/HA/HB/HC/ENC_A/ENC_B/ENC_Z, x1/board. Same connector family as the 4p control connector (deviation from requirements.md's 'wider white connector/FFC' guess - architect chose JST-GH for both, a reasonable single-family standardization; noting as the family choice, not a spec conflict since blocks.md already settled this at P2).
SWD programming header, 2x5 1.27mm SMD, x1/board per blocks.md/requirements.md answer 8.

L201: LM5164 buck inductor, VM->+5V. Per LM5164 datasheet (C477928) Eq.20 at Fsw=400kHz (power_tree.md), Vin_nom=24V: L=22uH gives ~45% ripple (0.45A) at 1A rated load, in the datasheet's recommended 30-50% window. Eq.19 peak current at Vin_max=28V is ~1.23A; this part's 3A Isat and 125mOhm DCR give large margin. Shielded (magnetic shielded) per task requirement, x1/board.
R201: LM5164 RON on-time-programming resistor to GND. Datasheet Eq.15: RRON(kOhm) = VOUT*2500/FSW(kHz) = 5*2500/400 = 31.25k -> nearest E96 31.6k, sets ~400kHz per power_tree.md. x1/board.

R202: LM5164 FB divider top resistor (FB pin to VOUT), paired with the existing 10k (C25804) as the bottom leg to GND. R1=R2*(Vout/Vref-1)=10k*(5/1.2-1)=33.3k -> nearest E96 33.2k, sets +5V output (VREF=1.2V typ). x1/board.

CBST: LM5164 bootstrap capacitor between BST and SW pins, required to bias the internal high-side gate driver. Datasheet abs-max external BST-SW capacitance range 1.5-2.5nF, recommended 2.2nF. x1/board. Basic part.

C201: LM5164 +5V output capacitor. Datasheet Eq.21 (0.5% Vout ripple target) needs >3uF minimum at 447mA-class ripple; datasheet's own worked example and task spec both call for 22uF/10V+ X7R-class - this X5R 25V part covers the voltage/value with margin. x1/board. Basic part.

L202: TPS61040 boost inductor, +5V->+12V GVDD. TPS61040 datasheet (C7722) recommends 2.2-47uH depending on application; 22uH is within TI's typical-application range for this Vin/Vout/Iout class and keeps switching frequency (PFM, load-dependent) well under the 6us max on-time limit at the ~50mA GVDD design current (6 gates x 52nC x 20kHz = 6.24mA charge current + boost/driver Iq, power_tree.md). 1.05A Isat clears the 400mA (TPS61040) peak switch current limit with margin. Shielded per task requirement, x1/board.

D201: TPS61040 boost rectifier. TPS61040 datasheet's own recommended-Schottky table (Table 7-4) lists the MBR0520 (ON Semi, 20V) by name for this exact application; SOD-123 package, 20V >= 12V Vout + margin, 500mA >> peak inductor current. x1/board.

R203: TPS61040 FB divider top resistor (FB to VOUT), paired with the existing 10k (C25804) as the bottom leg to GND. R1=R2*(Vout/Vfb-1)=10k*(12/1.233-1)=87.3k -> nearest E96 86.6k (target Vout ~11.9V, within GVDD tolerance). x1/board.

F701/F702: control and sensor connector +5V PTC resettable fuses per blocks.md io section (0.2A hold each). 1206, 30V rating clears the >=6V requirement with margin, 460mA trip. x2/board (one per connector).

ESD protection for io connector signal lines: UART_TX, UART_RX (J701) and HALL_A/B/C, ENC_A/B/Z (J702). Per-line 5V bidirectional TVS, 15pF low-cap SOD-323 (per-line array acceptable per task spec). x8/board (2 UART + 3 Hall + 3 encoder), placed at the connector side before the series/pull-up resistors.

R301: DRV8300D DT (deadtime) strap resistor to GND. Datasheet table: 40kOhm -> ~200ns typ deadtime (variable-deadtime VQFN mode); 40.2k is the nearest E96 standard value. x1/board. MODE pin (non-inverting GLx polarity) is strapped with the existing 10k (C25804) pull-down to GND rather than left floating.
Current-limiting resistor for D601-D603 (power/status/fault LEDs) on +3V3, ~1.3mA per LED at Vf~2V. x3/board, one per LED. Basic part.
Bulk decoupling for STM32G431 VDD (in addition to per-pin 100nF, existing C14663), standard practice for this MCU family. x1/board. Basic part.
LM5164 Type-3 ripple injection RA (BUCK_SW to the CA/CB node), added after the P4 review. Basic part.
C212: TPS61040 feed-forward cap across R204 (datasheet eq. 6, ~875 pF at 10 mA GVDD load). Basic part.
